URL: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-iran-deal-memorandum-of-understanding-text/
(Retrieved via WebFetch; structured summary of the 14-point MOU text)

Signing date as given by CBS News: Wednesday, June 18, 2026
Signatories: President Donald Trump (USA) and President Masoud Pezeshkian (Iran)

1. Immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts, including in Lebanon.
2. Respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity; no interference in internal affairs.
3. Comprehensive agreement to be finalised within 60 days, extendable by mutual consent.
4. US begins removing naval blockade immediately on signing; complete within 30 days; force withdrawal within 30 days after final deal.
5. Iran provides free safe passage for commercial vessels for 60 days between Persian Gulf and Sea of Oman; demining completed within 30 days.
6. US commits to a reconstruction plan worth "at least USD $300 billion" for Iran's economic development.
7. US pledges to end all sanctions including UN resolutions and unilateral measures on an agreed schedule.
8. Iran reaffirms it "shall not procure or develop nuclear weapons"; enriched material disposition via IAEA-supervised down-blending.
9. During negotiations Iran maintains nuclear programme status quo; US refrains from new sanctions or additional force deployments.
10. US Treasury immediately issues waivers permitting Iranian crude oil and petroleum product exports.
11. US undertakes to make frozen Iranian funds "fully usable".
12. Executive mechanism established to monitor implementation.
13. Negotiations on remaining points proceed after implementation begins.
14. Final deal requires endorsement through a binding UN Security Council resolution.
